title: Tech startups and VC firms are hiring for "ecosystem" roles, like "startup ecosystem lead", to prioritize in-person networking and cut through AI marketing slop (Lora Kelley/New York Times)
summary: Lora Kelley / New York Times: Tech startups and VC firms are hiring for “ecosystem” roles, like “startup ecosystem lead”, to prioritize in-person networking and cut through AI marketing slop — The people ushering in the artificial intelligence revolution are also doubling down on in-person relationships in their own industry.
contentText:
Lora Kelley / New York Times :

Tech startups and VC firms are hiring for “ecosystem” roles, like “startup ecosystem lead”, to prioritize in-person networking and cut through AI marketing slop   —  The people ushering in the artificial intelligence revolution are also doubling down on in-person relationships in their own industry.
